name: Fleet Management
description: At-a-glance view of Bitcoin miners on the local network

fleet_name.name: Fleet name
fleet_name.description: Heading shown above the fleet overview

device_names.name: Device names
device_names.description: JSON object mapping a device name or host to a friendly name shown in the per-model device list. Keys are the device's mDNS name before the first "._" (e.g. "miner-a", "Bitaxe Gamma 602 (A1B2)") or the host/IP as entered in manual hosts (a port suffix is not part of the key). Example: {"miner-a": "Rack 3 left", "10.0.0.5": "Test bench"}

bos_password.name: BOS password
bos_password.description: Root password used to log into every BOS miner on the network. Stored as plain text and sent unencrypted over the local network (the miner APIs are HTTP-only).

ubos_username.name: uBOS username
ubos_username.description: User name used for HTTP Basic auth against every uBOS device on the network. Stored as plain text and sent unencrypted over the local network (the device APIs are HTTP-only).

ubos_password.name: uBOS password
ubos_password.description: Password used for HTTP Basic auth against every uBOS device on the network. Stored as plain text and sent unencrypted over the local network (the device APIs are HTTP-only).

model_whitelist.name: Shown models
model_whitelist.description: JSON array of model-name fragments to show; empty shows all (e.g. ["bmm101"])

model_blacklist.name: Hidden models
model_blacklist.description: JSON array of model-name fragments to hide

bos_enabled.name: Show BOS miners
bos_enabled.description: Include BOS miners in the fleet view and keep polling them

ubos_enabled.name: Show uBOS miners
ubos_enabled.description: Include uBOS devices in the fleet view and keep polling them

axeos_enabled.name: Show AxeOS miners
axeos_enabled.description: Include AxeOS miners in the fleet view and keep polling them

bos_hosts.name: BOS hosts
bos_hosts.description: JSON array of extra BOS hosts to poll, beyond mDNS discovery; each entry is host or host:port (e.g. ["10.0.0.5", "miner.local:8080"]). IPv6 literals must use bracket notation with an explicit port (e.g. [fe80::1]:80). A host also found via mDNS appears twice.

ubos_hosts.name: uBOS hosts
ubos_hosts.description: JSON array of extra uBOS hosts to poll, beyond mDNS discovery; each entry is host or host:port. IPv6 literals must use bracket notation with an explicit port (e.g. [fe80::1]:80). A host also found via mDNS appears twice.

axeos_hosts.name: AxeOS hosts
axeos_hosts.description: JSON array of extra AxeOS hosts to poll, beyond mDNS discovery; each entry is host or host:port. IPv6 literals must use bracket notation with an explicit port (e.g. [fe80::1]:80). A host also found via mDNS appears twice.
